page.title: Skull+Bones
page.t:
Size: SMALL
 Weapon Class: UNIQUE

IBM Text

Scale Plate pirates have long been rumored to employ Teladi builders and then commandeer their vessels after the work is complete. While the majority of captured constuction ships are typically sold for scrap, some of these units have gotten into hands of pirate warlords, who turned them into their flagships. In an attempt to revive the old legends of pre-shutdown pirate might, these heavily armed usints are converted into scavenger-carriers and called Galleons.\n\nThese ships typically sacrifice any defensive armamanets for raw offensive power, primarily to overwhelm and frighten their unfortunate victims. Drone and material storages are repalaced with hangars and cargo holds big enough to carry all of their plunder.
